reference_boundary: Prompt cache guidance is used only for API-backed runner pilots and token/cost governance. Durable ADK skills must keep semantic behavior independent of cache hits.

quality_gates: stable prefix contains durable policy, schemas and reusable examples
dynamic tail contains task-specific user context, logs and diffs
retention policy records whether in_memory, 24h or model_default is used
model support and unsupported in_memory cases are freshness-gated
cached token metrics are observed without becoming correctness criteria
cache misses must not change semantic behavior
must_not: treat cache hit rate as correctness evidence
put secrets into stable cache prefix
hardcode volatile model cache support without freshness source
depend on cache persistence for workflow state
